description: Make a card for a win, streak, perk, giveaway entry or winner announcement. Returns a public page and PNG image in square, story or link size. Uses supplied text; it does not verify a winner, grant a perk or publish a social post. Never put private tokens or coupon codes in a card.

fields.description: Template text: winner uses name, prize, from; streak uses days, habit, optional name; perk uses milestone, perk, from; entered uses giveaway, prize, from; announce uses title, winners (one per line), from.

site.description: Optional website backlink. Query strings and fragments are removed.

name: create_share_card
title: Make a share card
